workflow: Manual reconciliation of WhatsApp order confirmations and shipping updates against Shopify backend data due to unreliable or missing native integration.
trigger: Customer inquiries about order status or failed automated notifications.
current_workaround: Manually checking Shopify admin for order details and copying/pasting information into WhatsApp chat windows or using third-party Zapier scripts that frequently break.
consequence: Delayed customer responses, increased support ticket volume, and risk of sending incorrect order/shipping information.

workflow: Exporting campaign performance data from WhatsApp Business API platforms to Excel/Google Sheets because the platform's native reporting lacks granular segmentation or export capabilities.
current_workaround: Downloading CSV exports (if available) or manually copying metrics from dashboards into spreadsheets for analysis and visualization.
consequence: Significant time spent on manual data aggregation; high risk of human error in reporting; inability to create real-time dashboards.

workflow: Managing bidirectional sync between WhatsApp conversations and CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce) where contact history is not automatically logged or updated correctly.
trigger: New incoming messages or outbound campaigns.
current_workaround: Manually updating CRM notes after significant interactions or relying on fragile custom integrations/scripts that require constant maintenance.
consequence: Incomplete customer profiles, lost sales context, and compliance risks due to unrecorded communication history.

workflow: Handling template approval delays and number verification issues by manually coordinating with Meta/business managers while keeping customers waiting.
trigger: Need to send new promotional templates or onboarding new phone numbers.
current_workaround: Spending hours navigating Meta Business Manager interfaces, re-submitting rejected templates, and manually informing customers of delays.
consequence: Campaign launch delays, frustrated customers, and operational downtime for support teams.
